FBI Alleges Punjab Officer Aided Extortion Ring

The Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) has named a Punjab police officer in connection with an alleged extortion racket run by the Jaggu Bhagwanpuria crime syndicate. The officer is accused of assisting the syndicate in its operations. This development highlights potential cross-border criminal activities involving law enforcement officials.
